preconditions.description: The number of rows and columns must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '.X' for row in grid for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid must be either '.' (unmarked) or 'X' (marked).

preconditions.expression: not any(grid[0][i] == 'X' or grid[-1][i] == 'X' or grid[i][0] == 'X' or grid[i][-1] == 'X' for i in range(m))
preconditions.description: No marked cells can be adjacent to the edge of the grid.

postconditions.description: If no suitable grid exists, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by the grid.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '14' for row in grid for c in row)
postconditions.description: All unmarked cells must contain either the number 1 or 4.

postconditions.expression: all(int(grid[i][j]) % 5 == 0 for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if grid[i][j] == 'X')
postconditions.description: All marked cells must contain a multiple of 5.

postconditions.expression: all(int(grid[i][j]) == sum(int(grid[x][y]) for x, y in [(i-1, j), (i+1, j), (i, j-1), (i, j+1)] if 0 <= x < n and 0 <= y < m and grid[x][y] != 'X') for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if grid[i][j] == 'X')
postconditions.description: Each marked cell must contain the sum of the numbers in all adjacent unmarked cells.
